description: We are a team of passionate students from JNNCE ,Shivamogga working on Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data. Our goal is to build a farmer-friendly dashboard using NASA satellite data (rainfall, soil moisture) to give simple "plant now / wait" advice for local crops. We're looking for teammates skilled in web development, data analysis, UI/UX design, and presentation/communication. If you care about agriculture, climate, and real-world impact, join us!
